author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before read as a glyph (a 'Э' with a spiked hook), not a shrimp. Redrawn from Lucide shrimp mirrored to the reference pose: rostrum pill with an antenna hook at top-left, head bar, curled back ending in a tail point with a tail loop and flick, a segment arc and an eye. Reads as a shrimp at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Reference's four segment seams reduced to one segment arc plus the eye (8-unit spacing); long antenna reduced to the Lucide hook; tail fan shown as loop + flick.
